qc.blockOpened: QC block opened. {{n}} unreleased result(s) sent back for re-run.

qc.blockedNote: A documented passing run and sign-off are required to clear a block.
qc.clearBody: Select a newer passing run for the same instrument and analyte and document the corrective action.
qc.clearPlaceholder: e.g. recalibrated, reran control, within limits
qc.needPassingRun: No newer passing run yet: record one first.

qc.title: Quality control

ruleText.1_2s: One control beyond 2 SD: warning only.
ruleText.2_2s: Two consecutive controls beyond 2 SD on the same side: reject.
ruleText.R_4s: Range between controls exceeds 4 SD in one run: reject.
ruleText.4_1s: Four consecutive controls beyond 1 SD on the same side: reject.
ruleText.10x: Ten consecutive controls on the same side of the mean: reject.

release.guardNote: A report can only be signed when every result is validated, covered by passing QC and signed by an authorised signatory. Each channel needs patient consent.
release.sub: Sign validated reports and release them on consented channels.
release.title: Release

crit.ackBody: Confirm that the ordering clinician has been informed.
crit.signoffNote: Limits and acknowledgement windows need pathologist sign-off. Escalation cannot be switched off.
crit.sub: Critical results must be acknowledged within the configured window or they escalate.
crit.title: Critical values

set.staffPassportNote: Sign-in with Kiorex Passport maps a verified phone number to one staff member. Role, lab access and permissions always come from here, never from Passport.
set.neverFlags: QC blocks, authorised release, critical-value escalation, audit, consent and tenant isolation are not flags.
set.noTaxNote: VAT is a configurable line on invoices only. Labs file their own taxes; nothing is reported by this product.

modeNote.STANDALONE: Nothing is sent to or accepted from partner systems. Orders, results, billing and reports all work inside this laboratory.
modeNote.INTEGRATED: Partner clients (Kiorex bookings, Kiorly Clinic hand-off, Kiorly Nurse samples) may send orders and receive released-report events. Local work is unchanged.

set.signinHint: Both methods stay available on the sign-in page. This only chooses which one is preselected for your team.

pat.title: Patients
pat.sub: Patient registry: demographics, history, trends, consent. Works on its own, no Kiorly Clinic needed.
pat.searchHint: Name, phone, MRN, e-mail or national-ID last 4
pat.conditionsHint: Comma separated, e.g. PREGNANT_T1; selects condition-specific reference ranges

pat.mergeNote: Choose the record to keep. The others are hidden and their visits move to it. This is audited.
pat.consentNote: Consent is recorded as an append-only history. Wording is pending approval.

reason.PHONE_DOB: Same phone and date of birth
reason.NAME_DOB: Same name and date of birth

ref.title: Referrers
ref.sub: Referring doctors and clinics: result delivery preferences, commission and credit accounts, doctor portal.
ref.name: Name
ref.creditHint: Leave empty to disable credit sales
ref.deliverOnRelease: Send the released report link automatically
ref.deliveryNote: Only sent when the patient consented to the doctor channel on that order. The message carries a secure link, never result values.

rec.title: Reception
rec.sub: Queue and token display, appointments with slot capacity.
rec.apptNote: Capacity per slot is set in Settings > Labs. Check-in issues a queue ticket; the order is created at the desk.

oe.referrerHint: Fills the doctor and enables commission and delivery preferences
oe.icdHint: Search a code or a diagnosis; selecting it can suggest tests
oe.cancelNote: A reason is recorded with who and when. Orders with work in progress cannot be cancelled.
oe.deliverNote: Sends the secure report link (never result values) to the patient or the referring doctor. Needs the patient's consent.

portal.title: Doctor portal
portal.sub: Your referred patients and their reports. Reports open only after release and only with the patient's consent.
portal.invalidHint: It may have been revoked. Ask the laboratory for a new link.
portal.privacy: Access is logged. Do not share this link.
portal.verifySuperseded: Genuine report, but superseded by version {{v}}
portal.verifyNote: Shows only that the report exists. No patient data.

sto.title: Storage and transport
sto.sub: Racks and freezers, retention and disposal, recollections, transport manifests with courier tracking.
sto.disposalNote: Stored samples whose retention window has ended. Tick and dispose; each disposal is added to the chain of custody.
sto.receiveNote: Scan or paste the barcodes that arrived (one per line). Anything missing is flagged.

mic.title: Microbiology and pathology
mic.sub: Culture and sensitivity with isolates and antibiotic panels; histopathology and cytology reporting with pathologist sign-out.
mic.breakpointNote: Enter S / I / R from your own breakpoint tables (CLSI / EUCAST are not built in). Untick "Report" to suppress an agent on the patient report.
mic.finalNote: The result now follows validation, signature and release on order
mic.orderItemHint: Culture tests in processing without a case yet
mic.addendumPrompt: Addendum text (the signed diagnosis is never edited)

qm.title: Quality management
qm.sub: QC lots, calibration, EQA, maintenance, non-conformances with CAPA, and the SOP library.
qm.goQc: Open Levey-Jennings charts and QC runs
qm.failNote: Required for a failed calibration; an NCR is raised automatically

tpl.noneHint: Without a template reports use the built-in English layout.
tpl.note: A report is rendered once, at signing, with the template active at that time and stored unchanged: editing a template never alters a signed report.

imp.title: Import the test catalogue from CSV
imp.note: Validate first: every row is checked and nothing is changed. Apply only runs when there are no errors. Existing codes are updated (reference ranges are versioned).
imp.unitsNote: Rename a unit everywhere it is used by analytes.

inv.title: Inventory
inv.sub: Reagents and consumables with lots and expiry, automatic deduction per test run, purchase orders, counts and cost per test.
inv.countNote: Completing posts a variance movement for every counted lot whose quantity differs.

fin.title: Finance
fin.sub: Income statement, receivables aging, expenses, referrer commissions and insurance contracts. VAT appears as a line only; nothing is reported to any authority.
fin.fromDrawer: Paid out of the cash drawer (reduces expected cash at close)
fin.coverageHint: The payer settles this share of each invoice; the patient pays the rest
fin.contractNote: The contract discount is applied automatically on every invoice of an order linked to the account.

ana.title: Analytics
ana.sub: {{n}} reports: workload, turnaround, positivity, revenue per test / referrer / branch, quality and inventory. Every report exports to CSV and PDF.
